entities.summary: Alexandra George Matthews is an English rugby union player. She made her debut for England in 2011 and was a member of the winning 2014 Women's Rugby World Cup and 2025 Women's Rugby World Cup squads. She currently plays for Gloucester–Hartpury Women's Rugby Football Club.
